pol-no-public-access.description: Storage buckets and databases must not allow public internet access.

pol-storage-encryption.description: All at-rest stored data must be encrypted with enterprise keys.

pol-user-mfa.description: Privileged and user accounts must enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).

pol-firewall-admin-ports.description: Administrative management ports (SSH/RDP) must not be openly exposed.

rotate_credentials.description: Safely rotate access keys and passwords for a compromised asset using HashiCorp Vault.

isolate_host.description: Sever host network connectivity via EDR quarantine while maintaining forensic agent communication.

rescan_asset.description: Trigger an immediate on-demand vulnerability and exposure scan against target asset.

user_memories.content: Prefers security reports formatted with executive summary followed by CVE remediation matrix.
Typically requests automated Jira ticket generation for any asset with risk score >= 80.
Cloud Security Architect responsible for AWS IAM, Vault secrets, and perimeter network security.
